title: Generalized Model Predictive Path Integral Control as Expectation--Maximization
summary: Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is a powerful sampling-based method for solving stochastic optimal control problems and has enabled real-time control in complex robotic systems. Despite its empirical success, its theoretical understanding remains limited. In this work, we show that MPPI can be interpreted as a special case of the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm applied to a probabilistic inference formulation of optimal control.
